item.title: Humans and dogs have influenced each other for 15,000 years
item.description: Dogs and humans have shaped each other for about 15,000 years, evolving from hunter-gatherer partners into a wide variety of breeds.

item.title: Potato farming may have given Andeans a genetic advantage
item.description: The rise of potatoes in the Andes appears to have influenced human DNA. Indigenous Peruvians carry high numbers of a starch-related gene variant.
